tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma skyer sgang pa'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so// bla ma mnyam med rin chen dang / /rtogs ldan zhang sgom zhabs la 'dud/ /tshad med 'gro skyob snying rje'i sku/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyi brlabs/ /dang por dad pas chos sgor zhugs/ /bar du thugs rje chen po bsgrubs/ /de rjes bla ma sangs rgyas bsten/ da lta 'bras bu mngon gyur to/ /de yang bdag gi pha yul nang gong gnam sa/ rus pa 'bal yin te/ /de la dang po lo bcu gnyis nas gshin rje gshed la bsnyen pa skyel/ bcu bdun pa la skyer sgang du khu bo 'bal thams cad mkhyen pa can du rab tu byung na/ byams pa'i chos lnga dang / spyod 'jug bslabs btus/ bstan rim rnams zhus/ de nas 'bal tshad ma ba lha sar chos 'khor la gdan drangs pa'i phyag phyir phyin pas/ grwa ba gcig gis ston mo byas pa'i rnam bzhag la dar yug ser po gsum/ zangs gcig phye dang mar mang tshad gcig phul nas brag lha'i mdun du gro thon nas nye'u 'don pa la phyin pas/ blo phug gi khang chung gcig na sa dkar btang ba gcig 'dug pas/ de mthong ba tsam gyis blo sna 'gyur ba gcig byung nas/ khang chung ya gi na su yod pa yin byas pas/ lha sa sde bzhi'i nye'u 'don pa rnams na re/ 'phags pa gcer sgom bya ba thugs rje chen po'i grub thob gcig yod pa yin zer nas/ de la mos par byung nas/ dar dang zangs dang phye dang mar khyer nas phyin te/ bla mas thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs lags sam zhus pas/ thugs rje chen po yin nam ma yin cha med/ grib kyi thad ka 'di na tshur skya na ra ra ba gcig gtan du 'ong gin 'dug pa yin gsung nas/ /'o na thugs rje chen po zhu dgos byas pas/ thog mar rig gtad gyi dbang byed dgos gsungs nas mar khal gnyis la mar me byas/ /gnyis la btsa' tu'i ston mo byas/ /dar yug gsum dang zangs phul te/ /sgrub thabs tshar gsum zhus nas/ /bla mas lo du nas zhal gzigs byas pas/

ngas ston ka bsod nams re byas/ /de nas mtshams bcad nas bsgrub pas/ /lo ngo brgyad lon tsa na nang gcig tsha ba thon nas nyi ma la 'gro dgos snyam tsa na/ nga sdod pa'i brag phug na ku dir ri ri ba'i sgra gcig 'dug nas/ su yin snyam nas phyin tsa na/ nga'i sdod pa de na gtso 'khor gsum po ma ṇi dir ri ri zlos shing 'dug pa mthong nas yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig phul/ de nas bzung nas gtan du 'bral ma myong bar zhal mthong ba yin gsungs so/ /de nas skyer sgang du phyin nas/ da yang na g.yag gu shi ba dang / yang na byang tsha lon pa la gtad dgos/ mi lus lan gcig thob pa 'di yang na nga rang shi ba dang gcig yang na thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong ba gcig la gtad dgos/ don med gcig la mi tshe stong zad byas pas mi yong bas sgrub dgos snyam ste/ mtshams byed kha ma la khams pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis rta btags ber skon dar brkyangs nas/ khyod gzhon dus su thos pa ma byas na 'bal tshad ma ba rabs chad pas dka' bzhi la mkhas pa gcig byed dgos zer ba la ma nyan pas grwa pa rnams gros byas te/ dbon po mtshams byed pa la phye chu dang shing gcig kyang ma skyel gcig phar 'gro tshur 'gro thams cad kyis sgo la rdo ba rgyob cig de ltar byas na kho sun nas slob gnyer la tshud par 'ong zer nas khrims byas so/ /de nas ngas mtshams dam po bcad nas thugs rje chen po bsgrubs pas/ grwa pa phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa kun gyis rdo rgyab nas/ dka' bzhi'i dbus na mar byang shad shad pa mi byed par/ sngags kyi 'khos kha'am/ khyod la ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zer ba gcig ka las mi 'ong gis/ zer nas rgyags gcig kyang ma skyel lo/ /de nas zhag re la skyo tsha phor pa re yang res myong res ma myong / de'ang ma myong bar thal ba dang chu bsres nas 'thungs nas/ gnyid gti mug yin/ gti mug nyon mongs pa yin/ de snga yang nyon mongs pa 'di kas 'khor bar skyur ba yin snyam nas gnyid kyang ma log par nyin mtshan med par ma ṇi pad me bgrangs pas rlung langs nas 'go 'gas pa bzhin byung nas ske rags kyi mgo bsdams nas/

bzlas pa lo gnyis byas pas rtags ci yang ma byung nas sbyin sreg chen mo byas pas sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rnams byung na yang zhal ma mthong bas/ lo phyed dang bzhi song ba'i nyi ma phyed na yi mug nas brag mgo gcig tu skyo sangs la phyin pas nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon khrug khrug 'dug nas/ ngas lo phyed bzhir skyo tsha phor re yang ma myong bar bzlas pa drag po byas pas rlung langs nas 'dug rbab tu 'chor snyam nas brag gi phug tu bcar byas pa dang / mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon gyi dkyil du jo bo thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum po 'dzum yer bzhugs kyin 'dug nas/ jo bo thugs rje re chung ngas lo phyed dang bzhi zhag re la skyo tsha pho re yang ma myong ba la/ de bas snga bar zhal mi ston pa byas pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas khyod kyis sgrub pa byas nas zhag gsum nas nga dang 'bral ba gcig kyang med pa yin te/ khyod rang gi las ngan ma zad pa dang / mthong na dga' ba'i re bas bkag pa yin gsungs nas/ de'i dus su/ tshad med yongs su dag pa thugs rje'i sku/ /chos nyid rnam dag gangs ri stims pa 'dra/ /skyon med rin chen pad+ma rtsegs pa'i steng / /gdung ba kun sel zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan/ /rdo rje dkyil dkrung bzhugs nas bdud bzhi mnan/ /tshad med 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i gtso 'khor gsum pa'i bstod pa byas so/ /de nas sngar bsnyen pa bskyal ba'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po de'i zhabs g.yas pa thag ma'i ri la slebs pa/ g.yon pa skyer sgang gi ri mnan pa/ phyag g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon pas sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ dbu skras nam mkha'i khams khengs pa gcig gi zhal mthong ngo / /de nas khu bo'i zhal nas shog dang gsungs nas phyin pas/ khyod kyis thugs rje chen po dang / gshin rje gshed kyi zhal mthong nas 'dug da khams pa rnams la nyan rgyu med/ thos pa byed pa bas sgrub pa byed pa khyab che bas/

da lta la stod na tsha ri sgom pa bya ba/ bla ma ras chung pa'i gdams ngag la mkhas pa'i grub thob gcig 'dug zer bas/ khyod der song gsungs nas dar yug drug dang / gser zho gang gnang nas gtsang du phyin pas nyi ma phyed tsa na la kha gcig tu slebs nas ngal gso bas/ nyi ma dro la ser phran drag po gcig babs nas/ nyi ma dro la ser ba drag po gnyis stabs su tshogs pa 'di 'tshar snyam pa gcig byung ba dang / ga re 'di thams cad rang gi sems su 'dug sems skye med chos skur 'dug snyam nas rang sems skye med du lhan gyis rtogs pa gcig byung bas/ phyis nas kyang de bas lhag pa'i bogs 'don rgyu ma byung ngo / /de nas la stod du bla ma'i bzhugs pa ri gcig gi chu 'gram du phyin pa dang / nye nas chu len pa dang 'phrad pas/ nga la phyag 'tshal gyin 'dug nas/ khyod nga la phyag 'tshal ba su dang nor byas pas/ kho na re da nang bla ma'i gsungs nas/ de ring dbus nas grub thob gcig nga la 'phrad du yong ba yod pas/ de thongs shig gsung ba yin/ da khyed du 'ong bar 'dug gzhan su dang yang mjal gyin med/ da gshegs zer nas brag lam gcig na yar phyin te/ bla ma la dar kha gang phul nas nga la rgyags zong tsam med pas/ bla ma ras chung pa'i gdams pa rnams myur du tshar ba gcig thugs la 'dogs pa zhu dgos byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal 'dzum mdzad nas/ khyod kyi gser dang dar yug drug po de zad tsa na ngas chos tshar bar byas yin gsungs/ ngas bla ma la brdzun de ka las zer ma myong / de nas gser dang dar btsongs bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma dang / phag mo lha bcu gsum ma la sogs pa'i dbang zhus nas lo gnyis la gdams pa rnams tshar bar gnang ngo / /de nas 'u yug tu bla ma spen phug pa chen po bya ba jo bo rje'i gsang sngags kyi bka' babs pa gcig yod zer nas/ bla ma spen phug pa dang mjal nas bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang mang du zhus/ lo lnga'i bar du jo bo'i gdams pa rnams gnang nas/

jo bo'i ḍa ma ru dang thugs dam gsum gnang ngo / /de nas shangs lha phu ba bla ma rmog cog pa bya ba sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs pa/ 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa'i grub thob chen po gcig bzhugs zer ba thos nas/ bla ma la mjal du phyin pas/ lam khar phyug po gcig gi gsang lam gyi na bza' gcig bskur/ de'i dgong mo der nyal bas/ mi nag po ras kyi ang ka rag gyon pa gcig byung na/ nangs par la la zla bo btsal nas dgra mi yong ba yod kyis/ ngas khyod kyi bran bzhin nyan gyis mi su thod thod la ma byin zhig gsungs nas/ mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas nang par la la zla bo mang po byung nas/ skru lung su bla ma mjal du phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mdang mi nag po gcig pur ma byung ngam gsungs/ byung lags byas pas de mgon po yin/ khyod kyi bran bzhin du nyan pa 'ong ba 'dug gsungs so/ /de nas mtshon cha can gyi dbang bskur mdzad nas sngon 'gro dang thabs lam gyi 'khrid tshar ba dang / bla ma'i zhal nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i chos drug 'di chig rgyud yin pas/ 'di ma lus pa gcig khyod la ster dgos/ 'di la spyi'i dbang bskur gcig dang sger gyi dbang bskur re yod pas/ mis ma tshor ba re byed dgos gsungs nas/ dang po thabs lam gyi dbang bskur nas/ me rgod gtum mo'i 'khrid rkyang pas/ zhag bdun nas res thub pa byung ba dang / da spyi'i dbang bskur byed dgos gsungs nas/ nam phyed na dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ bde mchog dang mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i zhal mthong / yang sang dgong sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur nas 'khrid bskyangs pas sgyu ma'i nyams bzang po byung nas snang ba'i bden 'dzin thams cad zhig nas song ngo / /de nas zla ba bcu gcig nas rmi lam gyi dbang skur nas/ rmi lam bzung bas zin pa dang / sbyong spel shes pa dus gcig byung nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ dbang po rab tu gyur pa la/ /zin dang sbyong spel mnyam du 'ong /

/bya ba yin gsungs nas nga la bstod ra mang du mdzad do/ /de nas rmi lam gyi stobs chen po byung ba dang / bla ma'i zhal nas nga'i nye gnas de tshong 'dus su ja 'don du song ba yin te/ da rung ma byung / kho la dgra byung ba yin nam/ do nub rmi lam zung la ltos shig gsungs nas nam phyed tshun la gsol ba btab/ tho rangs rmi lam bzung nas phyin pas/ kho tshong 'dus nas nyin gcig 'ongs pa'i sa nas ja sigs mgo chag gcig la sngas gtad nas 'dug ja sigs de'i nang na re bas btums pa gcig kyang 'dug nas/ nangs par bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin te/ nye gnas kyis ja lon nas ja sigs kyi nang na re bas btums pa gcig kyang gda' zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas re bas btums pa de ci ru gda' gsungs/ de ma shes zhus pas/ ting chu gcig re bas btums nas 'dug pa/ da rung bong bu a ma rang rgan par 'dug sgoms gsung ngo / /de nas zla ba bdun mtshams byas nas rmi lam gyi 'dun pa rtse gcig tu btang bas nyin par sgyu ma'i rtog pa rang shar du byung / mtshan mo rmi lam gzung nas u rgyan du phyin te/ slob dpon lwa wa pa la chig bsdus zhus/ yang mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la de nyid gsum gyi rdzogs rim dang / rtsa kha bcu pa'i gdams pa zhus/ yang rmi lam bzung nas rgya gar lho phyogs su slob dpon phyogs kyi go cha la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel zhus/ yang po ta lar phyin nas sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum pa'i zhal mthong nas gsol ba btab pas/ sgrol ma'i zhal nas/ sgyu lus bden med gnas yin a 'thas shig /rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad yin lam du khyer/ /'od gsal mos gus gnad yin gsol ba thob/ /gzhan phan snying rje'i gnad yin phyogs 'dzin spongs/ /bya ba la sogs pa'i chos gsungs so/ /de nas bla ma lha rje'i mchod pa'i dus su/ lha bzhi bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed gnyis kyis dbang bskur byas nas/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig sgrub pas spyi bo'i steng na nyin mtshan med par bzhugs pa zhag bdun du zhal mthong bas/

bla ma'i zhal nas/ da ni yi dam ni rgyun chad med par zhal mthong nas 'dug rmi lam gyi stobs ni chen po byung nas 'dug pas/ da mtshon cha can gyi grwa pa mang po chos sgo 'byed pa byed dgos/ khyod la mos par 'dug gsung ngo / /de nas dbyar gcig chos sgo phye ste/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs bshad pas/ dge sbyor gyi stobs kyang chung du song / 'du 'dzis g.yengs pas so yang ma sod par byung nas chos sgo 'byed pa de bshol te/ mtshams dam po bcad nas bsgoms kyang / dge sbyor de yun ring por sor chud du ma btub pas/ da dag pa'i sa gsum la ma sleb par mi zas dang gzhan don gcig kyang byar mi btub pa 'dug snyam pa byung ba dang / thugs rje chen po byon nas/ 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba bdud kyi bar chad yin/ /chags sdang sna tshogs grogs su mi 'char bas/ /rkyen ngan dben pa'i dgon pa rtag tu bsten/ /tshe la long med 'chi ba bsam par rigs/ /zhes so/ /de nas dge sbyor sor chud pa dang / tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma shar ma thag la/ dges rdor mtshon cha can gyi dkyil 'khor sku ri bo tsam yod pa zhig zhal mthong / de'i nyi shu gnyis la rmi lam bzung nas/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phyin pas rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal mthong / thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs so/ /dbang bzhi ma rdzogs smin par ga la nus/ /dbyer med bskyed rdzogs ma sgoms grol mi srid/ /thob 'dod re bas 'bras bu mi 'byin pas/ /rang shar rang grol sku gsum dbyer med ltos/ /zhes lan gsum gsungs pas/ cir snang thams cad bskyed rdzogs dbyer med du rtogs so/ /de nas mtshams bkrol ba dang / nub gcig gi rmi lam na yi ge a gcig gis bsus pa phar thal tshul thal du phug pas zug rngu chen po byung / yang lci ba dang reng bu dbang med du bza' dgos pa gcig rmis pa dang / nangs par bla ma'i gsung ma chogs par phyug po gcig gi bsnyen bkur la phyin pas de'i dgong mo lus bshags gtub byed pa bzhin na nas/

sman dang rim 'gro gang gis kyang ma phan par shi la thug pa dang / tho rangs ka sgrol ma dkar mo byon nas/ khyed kyi nad 'di sku blud bzos pas lan pa yin/ da gzhan cis kyang mi drag pas brul gtor thong zhig des dmyal ba'i las las thar zhing / nad las dgrol bar 'gyur ro/ /gsungs nas brul gtor btang bas nad drag po de sos so/ /de nas brul gtor 'di kho na la yid ches shing mos par byung ngo / /de nas bla ma la rgyud sde lnga'i dbang zhus nas/ dges rdor dang / dgra nag dang / 'jigs byed dang / rgyu sde lnga'i sgrub thabs dang / gdams pa rnams ma lus par zhus nas/ da ni shes bya'i sgrib pa ma dag bar du sgrub pa rang gcig pu bya dgos snyam tsa na/ nyin gcig rta pa sum brgya tsam byung nas a khu 'bal tshad ma ba grongs pas gdan sa la yong dgos zer nas byung ba la/ nga mi 'gro khyed rang rnams gdan sa gzhan la tshol/ nga ma shi ring la sgrub pa byed pa yin byas pas/ bla ma'i dam tshig la sbrel nas a khu'i gdan sa gyis/ dge sbyor 'phel bar yong gis ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa bran bzhin nyan pa'i bka' bsgo bya/ bu 'di ru ma sdod dbus su song / mgon po 'di bran bzhin nyan pa gcig 'ong ba 'dug gis gsungs nas/ de dus su skyer sgang du 'ongs bzhin nas sku 'bum brtsigs nas gdan sa byas/ da dgon pa 'di la lcags ri gcig bya dgos bsam pas/ gar dgos su rdo spungs nas byung ba dang / rmangs bting pas yul pas bcag nas de la nga ma dga' ba gcig byung ste/ bla ma'i zhal nas chos skyong bran bzhin du nyan pa gcig 'ong ba 'dug gsung ba yin te/ da lcags ri yang don med par khong gis bcag nas med do bya ba gcig khar shor bas/ de'i dgong mo lcags ri bcag pa'i mi tshang mang po gcig shi nas/ nangs par babs byas nas nga yang 'gyod pas bdun tshigs byas so/ /de nas da ni 'du 'dzis g.yengs nas 'gro bar 'dug snyam nas/

khu bo'i zla mchod ma gtogs pa mtshams dam po byas te/ gnyid tsam yang ma log par dgong mo sa rub nas nang nam ma langs bar la sku 'bum la skor ba byas/ nyin par mal sa nas ma g.yos par dge sbyor rtse gcig du byas pas/ rmi lam 'od gsal gyi stobs chen po byung nas/ nub gcig rmi lam bzung nas mchod rten dpal yon can du ltar phyin pas/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang na/ shel gyi mchod rten sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel ma ga ta'i khal gcig bre bdun bzhugs pa'i 'od zer sna lnga phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ 'od zer gyi sna la mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas mchod pa 'bul ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang thams cad rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs mang po rim pa bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol la lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang dri za'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba/ de lta bu gcig 'dug nas/ ngas kyang skad cig la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul nas phul ba dang / ḍā ki ma'i tshogs thams cad mgrin gcig tu rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i pu tsa ni e ma hoḥ zhes lan gsum gsungs pas/ gsang sngags kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer byung nas/ rigs kyi bu tshur shog dbang bskur bar bya'o gsungs nas/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba dang / lha dang dbang bskur ba dang / bdag dang mchod pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyang skye 'gag dang bral ba'i zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por rtogs nas/ rin chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang / rten yongs su dag pa'i mchod rten la/ rgyal ba bdun gyi mchod rten bzhugs/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa phul/ de yang dmigs med sgyu ma'i nyams/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por rtogs/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i mgur bzhes so/ /yang rmi lam bzung nas po ta lar phyin pas rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten lta bu'i steng na thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum po rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/

'od kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs nas 'dug khri 'phang rnams la kha sar pa ṇi byis pa lo brgyad pa'i na tshod ltar bzhugs nas/ chos kyi zhu ba po'i tshul du mdzad de/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za rnams/ /skyon bral snying rje chen po'i sku/ /theg chen chos rnams ston par 'gyur/ /gang mos don rnams dri bar byas so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / ri rab kyi gong nas pad+ma'i sdong bu la lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs thams cad mchod pa dpag tu med pa thogs nas 'khod de/ rang rang gi skad kyis kha sar pa ṇi la zhus/ kha sar pa ṇis gtso 'khor gsum po la zhus pa dang / thugs rje chen pos rang rang gi skad du/ skye gnas sbyangs ba dang gsang sgrub gsungs so/ /de nas gtso 'khor gsum po bcu gcig zhal du gyur nas/ de'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer byung nas bdag gi gnas gsum du phog pa dang / bdag kyang thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur nas bcu gcig zhal gyi dug gsum sbyang ba'i gdams ngag dang / gzungs rings kyi bzlas thabs rnams gsungs nas/ dus der bcu gcig zhal gyi bstod pa de mdzad do/ /de'i nangs par kyang ji lta ba bzhin mthong nas lung bstan te/ po ta la'i gzugs bzhengs shig de mthong ba thams cad ngan song las thar nas mthar thug thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsungs so/ /yang nub gcig mdo bo na bla ma lho pa bde mchog gi dbang skur byed cing yod zer bas rmi lam bzung nas ltar phyin pas/ bla ma lho pa de he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gyur nas bum pa bzung ste slob ma la bde mchog dngos kyi dbang bskur bar 'dug nas/ da lta bod na bde mchog dngos kyi dbang bskur ba bla ma lho pa las mi 'dug go /yang dung rung sgang pa dbang skur byed cing yod zer bas dngos gzhi'i srod la rmi lam bzung nas bltas pas/ gzhi de'i klu srin mo gcig gis gtor ma zos rang byung gi khrag snying khar byugs pas/

slob ma thams cad 'thabs nas rma zhar mang po byung bas/ nangs par dung rung sgang pa nam langs ma thag nga'i tsar byung ba la/ dge bshes dbang skur nyes sam byas pas/ mdang 'thab mo byung lags zer/ gtor ma mi thub par dbang skur byed pas gang na 'ong / khyed rang gi klu srin mo des bar chad byed cing 'dug pa yin/ da ngas rten 'brel gcig byas pas tshe sring gis byas nas/ mar me sbar ba gcig kho la gtad nas 'di khyer la shangs kyi dgon par khyer la bshags pa gyis shig byas tsa na/ lam khar ja 'thung gin bsdad pas mar me lam du zad nas khong gis yar sleb ma thag bshags pa bya long med par khrag bskyugs nas shi 'dug pas/ dbang skur dus su bgegs bskrad pa dang / chos skyong la bka' bsgo byed pa gal che bar 'dug go /de nas dgong mo gcig 'bum pa la skor ba byed kyin yod pa'i dus su/ nam mkha' las 'od chen po byung nas bltas pas/ drang srong ra hu la mgo dgu pa/ lag na mda' gzhu thogs pa/ mgo bo dang lus po thams cad mig gis khengs pa/ kha nas klog 'khyug pa/ sku mdog dud dkar yod pa/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nam mkha' khengs pa/ sku shin tu che ba/ 'jigs pa gcig mthong nas/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum po sems can thams cad drang srong gi 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol byas pa dang / ra hu la'i g.yon phyogs su lha mo dkar mo byon pa/ /bu khyod rang gi sems la ltos/ /'jigs pa rang sems bdud du babs/ /lus kyi gces 'dzin gtan nas spongs/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan la/ /ci phyir 'jigs dang skrag par byed/ /gzhan yang gsol ba 'debs pa de/ /legs par bstan gyis gus pas nyon/ /tsan+dan gor shi sha'i tshal pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan bris nas lus la btags na drang srong gi 'jigs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/

/de nas zla ba gcig na ti si nas ri pa sum brgya tsam byung nas/ /chos rje grongs zer nas 'ongs pa yin te/ la la na re ma grongs sam zer bas/ do nub rmi lam bzung la gzigs par zhu zer bas/ da lta bla ye na chos bshad kyin 'dug byas pas/ khong rnams lkog shub byed cing 'dug 'di grub thob yin nyen yod/ rtogs ldan du mi 'dug sngags 'di tsam 'dren gyi 'dug da res khong gi mngon shes 'di thog tu phebs na/ rang re thugs rje chen po zhu dgos zer gyin 'dug de nas ngas rtsa gang yin/ 'dud pa gang yin/ grol ba gang yin/ grol ba'i dgos pa gang yin/ tsan dan gor shi sha gcig kyang bskur bar zhu byas nas/ ri pa rnams la yi ge bskur bas/ bla ma 'bri gung pas g.yu khang du dbu che rnams bsags nas/ yi ge 'di la lan ji ltar bskur byas pas/ ma mthun te/ bla ma rang gis rtsa nyon mongs pa/ 'dud pa dug gsum gyi rtog pa/ grol ba nyon mongs pa las grol pa/ dgos pa don gnyis mthar phyin pa'o/ /bya ba dang tsan dan dang / zi bol dang / gos chen mang po bskur nas byung ngo / /de nas bla ma la sogs pa dang / ri pa mang pos thugs rje chen po zhus nas/ khong rnams kyi tshe stod smad la ji ltar byung ba dang / ma 'ongs pa rnams bshad de/ thugs rje chen po lo gsum bsgrub par khas blangs so/ /de'i rjes la 'ga' dang / rgya'i rgyal pos gzungs chus phan thogs pa'i 'bul ba yin zer nas dngul bre dang / dar zab dang gser mang po gzhung 'gron pa la bskur nas byung bas/ dngos po dag pa ci byung yang bla ma la dngos nas bsags pas/ g.yu sum cu/ snam bu stong / 'bri gzhon sum cu so dgu rta bcu gsum/ snag tsha'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gcig gser gyi nyi khri gcig ja sigs dang ber thul dang / dkar yol la sogs pa'i dngos po ci yod thams cad bla ma'i phyag tu btang dgos snyam nas 'bul ba skyel rogs btsal bas/ skyer sgang pa'i grwa pa rnying pa rnams 'tshogs nas/

'bal thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdan sa nas gzhan du 'bul ba skyel ba mi 'thad pas/ rang re thams cad 'bul ba skyel ba'i rogs mi byed zer nas gros byas pas/ shangs pa na re khong rnams khrims byas nas 'bul ba skyel rogs mi nyan par snang bas/ ci 'thad pa yin zer ba la/ ngas dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa yin te/ 'o na yang chos skyong rang gis bsgrub pa min nam byas pa dang / nyi ma phyed yol ba dang / ral gu rong phrug gyon pa/ ske rags dmar po'i thod bcings pa/ rta nag po bzhon pa gcig byung nas/ khyed la 'bul ba skyel rogs med na/ zla bo bzang po 'dug ste zer bas/ gang na 'dug byas pas/ 'phan yul ba'i tshong pa mang po gcig do nub mon grwar 'ong ba 'dug sang nub sga ru gnas su 'ong bar 'dug zer bas/ sang dgong gzhon tshul sga ru gnas su ltar btang bas 'dug rta nag po bzhon pa'i mi bdun mdzo pho mo mang po rol du khrid nas 'dug la/ khyed rnams gang du 'gro byas pas shangs su 'gro zer nas/ 'o na nged kyi 'bul ba skyel rogs byed dgos pas/ skyer sgang du 'deng byas pas/ nged rnams sang yong gis khyed rang grabs gyis zer tsa na/ nangs par nam langs pa dang mi rta rnams byung nas/ nged kyi mdzo 'di rnams la khal khol/ khyed rang gi rnams la yang khal khol/ nged kyi rta 'di la bla ma chibs shig zer nas rta nag gcig btang bas/ de'i dgong mo ba lung dgon par bsdad do/ /de nas khong rnams la/ shi gu la thag nye/ 'jigs pa che bas ji ltar bya byas pas/ khyed kyi cha rkyen de bas che ba nged kyi gro phad 'di na yod de/ nged kyis skyel ma thub nas 'ong gis zer ro/ /de nas lha phur dgong kha sleb tsa na/ khong rnams na re do nub phyin na ku lungs su sleb par 'dug ste/ do nub mi thongs la 'bul ba pur shog gyis/ sang snga dro la slebs par yong gis/ kha sang khyed la 'bul ba skyel rogs mi 'dug zer bas bsu bar 'ongs pa yin/

do nub dur khrod mun pa mi zad pa bya ba na/ slob dpon dha na sang kri ta bya ba tshogs 'khor byed par yod pas nged rnams de ru 'gro zer nas rdul tshub du gyur nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas ngas shangs chung la skyel skyer sgang pa rnams la ma shod cig khong dpon slob 'dre'i khrid pa yin zer 'ong byas so/ /de nas nangs par bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin tsa na/ bla ma'i zhal nas dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos tshul bzhin du gyis shig dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bran bzhin du nyan par 'dug byas pa/ kha sang bar ri rab kyi zom la gnas pa'i mgon po'i 'khor rnams na re/ dbon ston la 'bul ba skyel rogs mi 'dug pas bsu bar 'gro ba yin zer nas song ba yin te ma byung dam gsungs nas/ der bsu bar byung lags/ mdang slob dpon dha na sam kri ta dang / dharma ka shi ka'i tshogs 'khor la 'gro zer mi snang bar thal byas so/ /de nas bla ma la 'bul ba byas pa'i dgong mo gtor dbang gcig mdzad nas lha mo dang 'khor bzhi'i sgrub thabs dang / nyi khros kyi ser ba dang / gshin rje rwa sgrol la sogs pa'i gnad rnams ma lus par gnang ngo / /yang dbang bskur gsum mdzad nas/ snang ba la brten nas bla ma lam du 'khyer ba dang / yid dam lam du 'khyer ba dang / sgyu ma lam du 'khyer ba ste/ lam 'khyer gyi chos gsum dang / gzhan yang zab chos lhag ma thams cad ma lus par gnang nas/ dbang skur snying (dbu snyung )yang bzhes so/ /de nas mar la 'ongs nas skyer sgang du slebs pa'i dgong mo/ /chu bdag wa ru ṇa byung nas/ shing sdong skam po gcig la me tog lnga skyes pa gcig 'bul du byung ba la/ 'di ci'i gda' yin byas pas/ rabs chad po gcig la bu lnga 'ong ba'i brda yin/ sang phyug po rdo rje 'bum gdan 'dren du 'ong ba yod pas/ nga la gtor ma bzang po gcig thongs/ kho la bu spun lnga yong bar 'gyur ro/ /zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/

/de nas phyug po rdo rje 'bum rig gtad/ sne len byed pas byon par zhu zer nas der phyin te/ khye khal brgyad la las byas pa'i gtor ma brul gtor gcig btang bas/ gtor ma'i mdun du wa ru ṇa byung nas/ shing skam po gcig la me tog lnga yod pa gcig phul nas/ phyug po 'dis rtag tu zhabs tog byas nas bu med na ngo tsha bar 'dug zer nas thal lo/ /de nas dgongs gcig wa ru ṇa byung nas/ kho rang gi sgrub thabs phul nas da nga la gtor ma byin la na ya ga'i steng na/ klu yid bzhin nor bu yod pas 'bul ba yin zer nas/ der gtor ma de skyel te/ klu yid bzhin nor bu'i dngos grub blangs pas/ de las 'tsho ba thams cad rtsol med du byung ba dang gzhon tshul na re/ rdo ljongs des cang mi btub snyam tsa na/ rdo de lag tu byung nas zas nor ci yang byung zer ro/ /yang ston zla ra ba la dbon ston gzhon brtson chos bshad kyin 'dug pas/ k+ṣe tra pa la dang wa ru ṇa gnyis kyis kho'i chos khri sgyel gyin 'dug nas/ de sgyel ba ci yin byas pas/ wa ru ṇa kho na re/ chos pa bya ba bsam pa bzang po dgos pa yin no/ /'di zhe nag par 'dug pas sgyel ba yin zer 'dug pas/ gzhon brtson la shangs pa'i chos gcig kyang mi ster ba yin no/ /des na chos pa la bsam pa bzang po dgos pa 'dug bsam pa byung ngo / /yang tshes brgyad kyi snga dro ston gzhon gyis wa ru ṇa'i gtor ma bshams pas/ wa ru ṇa kho byung nas sna tsha grib byung bas gtor ma mi 'dod zer/ grib ci las byung byas pas/ ston gzhon gyi lag pa mi gtsang bar 'dug zer bas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra gal che bar 'dug go /yang dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bdun gyi nub mo rmi lam bzung nas u brgyan du phyin pas/ slob dpon pad+ma dang mjal nas/ dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zab pa gcig zhu dgos byas pas/ skad cig la slob dpon rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa gcig tu gyur nas rta skad thengs gsum bton pas/

ma mo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad 'dus nas dpal rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur ro/ /de nas pad+ma rgyal po'i zhal nas/ ngas rta mgrin gyi rgyud sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rta mgrin rol pa'i rgyud las btus pa'i gsang sgrub gcig snye mor sbas pa sngags pa gcig gis thon nas yod pas der zhus shig rgyal po dang pe kar dang / dkor 'dre dang / 'gong po'i tshogs thams cad dang / lha ma srin sde brgyad 'joms par byed do gsungs nas lung bstan pas/ snye mor phyin nas slob dpon sngags pa la gsang sgrub zhus so/ /de nas yang rmi lam bzung nas slob dpon pad+ma la zhus pas/ lan gsum gyi bar du gsungs nas/ da rung 'khor lo ma byin 'dug pas zhus shig gsungs so/ /yang nyi khri gcig dang bur tam gcig ras snam gnyis khyer nas zhus pas 'khor lo gnang ngo / /yang tshes bco brgyad la lha sar phyin pas po ta rir thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi zhal mthong nas nam mkha' thams cad 'od kyis khengs pa byung ba dang / yang rtsa zhal nas 'od kha dog mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa lnga byung nas/ nged dpon g.yog nyi shu rtsa lnga la phog pas/ de dus de nyid du ting nge 'dzin bzang po rgyud la skyes so/ /de'i dgong mo 'khrul snang la bya yul ba 'gas rigs gtad zhus pa'i rjes la/ bcu gcig zhal gyi bzhad zhal 'od zer byung 'khrul snang thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab bar gyur to/ /de nas bcu gcig zhal dbang zhus nas sam/ sgrub thabs zhus pa rnams de'i dus kho nar dge bshes grags yes yi ger bkod do/ /yang de'i tho rangs jo bo shākya la yan lag bdun pa gcig phul nas byang chub ltung bshags gcig bton tsa na/ lcags sgo'i steng na su kha ma sid+dhi lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod tsam yod pa sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar ba/ dbu skra sil bus sku stod non pa/ phyag g.yas rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pa/

g.yon sdig mdzub thugs kar gtad pa gcig rigs kyi bu nyon zhig nam mkha' rig med stong pa la/ /rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba bcun/ /rtsa ba bcun dang lhug par zhog /gsungs nas gsung lhang lhang bzhugs pa gcig mthong ngo / /de nas brag lha blo phug tu 'phags pa'i bzhugs sar/ rig gtad byas nas phyin pa dang / mtsho'i dkyil na pad+ma'i sdong po rgyas pa gcig gi steng na thugs rje chen po rtsa phyag bdun cu pa gcig bzhugs nas klu rnams la chos gsung gin 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de nas brag lha gnad kyi mdun du gtor ma gcig btang bas/ phyag bzhi pa'i g.yas na sgrol ma/ g.yon na khro gnyer can bzhugs pa gcig mthong nas/ dug gsum zhi mdzad kyi gsol 'debs byas pas/ sgrol ma'i zhal nas/ gnyis 'dzin spangs na 'dod chags ngang gis zhi/ /pha mar shes pas zhe sdang rang sar grol/ /gsal la rtog med gti mug dbyings su thim/ /'gag med dug gsum rang sar 'ching byed 'di/ /der 'dzin med pas rang sar grol bar nges/ /nyon mongs rang shar rang grol nyid du ltos/ /ces lha so so'i gsung ngo / /de nas yang brag lha'i klu des rig gtad dang gzungs chog zhus nas zhag gsum blo phug tu bsdad do/ /de nas skyer sgang du phyin tsa na/ ngam shod pa'i dge bshes phar phyin pa gsum mjal du byung ba dang / nam mkha' la zla ba gcig shar nas byung la/ drang srong gis bzung nas byung bas/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum po drang srong gis bzung ba'i zla ba 'di btang du gsol byas pa dang / dum pa gcig btang byung bas dge bshes kyi ltas su 'dug pas/ khyed la tshe ring po mi yong bar 'dug ngas en tsam gcig bsrings nas yod/ da dgon par thugs rje chen po bsgrub la lo gsum nas 'dir shog cig gsungs so/ /de nas dge bshes des/ lo gsum nas thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong nas/ nga dang mjal du byung ste bla ma chen po da nga'i don grub zer ba dang /

da zhag gsum gyi snga dro la dgon par sleb par 'dug sleb ma thag tu spong dag gyis/ dgon pa sdod byas pas/ khos slebs ma thag tu de bzhin byas pa dang / khong grongs nas 'ja' tshon du song zer ro/ /yang ngam shod nas dge bshes chos rgyal byung nas/ bla ma da nga la 'dod chags gtan nas dag 'dug phar phyin ltar byas na rgyud tshod mtho rab song gda'/ de ltar yin yang bla ma la zhur 'ongs pa yin zer nas/ klu srin mos bar chad byas nas 'dug pa/ 'dod chags dag gam ma dag lta yis byas te/ rdo rje dril bu mgo thog tu bzhag nas byin rlabs byas pa dang / kho brgyal nas dran med du song ba dang / klu srin mo yang bros nas song ste/ kho 'dod chags me 'bar ba bzhin song nas/ de sngar gdon gyis bar chad byung ba ma shes par 'dug da chags pa rang dag la 'gro ba gcig zhu dgos zer nas keng rus ta ra'i gdams pa btab pas/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po byung ngo / /dkar chung rgyal pos sna drangs pa'i mdze pho bcu gsum la zungs chu byin pa tsam dang / rdo rje dril bu mgo thog du bzhag pa tsam gyis mdze thon pa byung ngo / /yang yol ba'i dge bshes zhang btsun bya ba gcig smyo ba 'dul du byung nas/ khyed kyis rgya gar du skye ba snga ma la slob dpon jo mo can gcig la ba phyug 'dra byas nas 'bar bas rgyun byas nas bshags pa legs par gyis/ rkyen lo re rgyal pos byas nas 'dug pa la/ ngas ltas stangs gcig byas pas kho'i smyo ba thul lo/ /des na rnam thar gang la yang log lta mi byed pa 'di gal che bar 'dug go yang nga la mon dra ba gcig gis sman bla'i lder bzo gcig gi rab gnas bcol bas/ de'i mthe'u chung ma legs par 'dug pas/ sman bla'i mthe'u chung ma legs byas pas/ de nas zhag 'ga' nas mthe'u chung na bar byung ba dang / rje btsun ma sgrol ma byon nas khyod kyis lder bzo'i ma byas par/ sman bla'i byas pas ngag gi nyes pa 'dir nad du smin pa yin pas/

sman bla'i lder bzo'i drung du bshags pa gyis shig gsungs nas/ de bzhin byas pa grag pa dang / rnam smin 'di phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem pa dang / de ma thag tu bshags pa gal che bar 'dug go /yang dre bo mgon po sha ba rgyug 'gyel gyi gdams ngag 'tshong gin 'dug nas/ de mi gsod kyi shan pa dre bo mgon po byas nas thengs 'ga' 'bar bas/ khong grongs nas pur sbyangs pa'i dus su rmi lam bzung nas ltar phyin pas bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga pur khang gi steng na zhal phyir gzigs nas 'dug pa de ngas phyin pa dang nang du gzigs kyin 'dug pas/ bdag med ma nga la zhal bstan du gsol byas pas/ khyod kyis sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la 'bar yod pas bshags pa gyis shig gsungs/ bshags pa byas pa dang / dgyes rdor yab yum gnyis kyis a li ka li'i bshags pa bstan te/ bshags pa byas pa dang / bdag med ma'i zhal nas rigs gyi bu/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /rnam thar dpag par mi nus kyi/ /thams cad mkhyen par ma gyur tshe/ /gzhan rgyud khong du mi chud kyis/ /mnar med skye ba'i las la soms/ /rang rgyud ngan pas dag snang sbyongs/ /mthol bshags gnyis dang 'bral ma byed/ /ces gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas phag mo grub pa'i zhi byed rmang lam ma de zhu dgos snyam nas gsol ba btab pas/ dam pa byon nas dug gsum lam 'khyer gyi zhi byed gsungs nas/ da gsang sgrub gyi skyabs 'gro'i skor la nga bsgoms la gsol ba thob cig ngas kyang byin gyis brlab par bya'o gsungs so/ /de nas sgor rgyal tsha nyal nas 'dug pa phyir byung yang nyal nas nangs par bla mas/ nā ro pa'i yig chung dang zhi byed rmang lam ma de byin na dga' ba la snyam nas 'dug pas/ nangs par bos nas mdang nub mo khyod kyis yid smon bting ba'i chos de gnyis bya yis byas pa dang / mdang gi mkhyen pa de thugs la btags te/ lar bla ma mi mkhyen dgu mkhyen nga yid la mi 'gyu dgu 'gyur ngo re tsha zer nas byung ngo /

/yang bzad pa'i rlung jo sras kyis sha mar nyi shu dang / snam bu brgyad nga la 'bul snyam nas byung ste/ sna 'bar du bsdad pa'i dgong mo kho'i slob dpon dang phrad nas/ bla ma thams cad srog gcig pas 'dra snyam nas sha mar gnyis dang snam bu gcig phul/ de nas srod la dge sbyor bag tsam byas nas gnyid log 'dug nas nangs par nga dang phrad du byung tsa na/ nga la bsngos pa'i sha mar dang snam bu gzhan la 'bul ma thag de las sdig che ba med pa yin/ nga la mtho dman med de/ tshong dpon bzang skyong gi mdo las/ sbyin no zhes ni khas blangs nas/ /gang zhig gzhan la ster byed pa/ /de las sdig che gang zhig yod/ /de las bslus pa gang zhig yod/ /ces gsungs pa yin/ da phyis de ltar ma byed cig dge sbyor mi byed tsa na phreng ba'i 'gel phur de ltar ma byed/ lha la brnyas par 'gro ba yin/ khyod sang gnangs tsa na grong gseb dang / grong 'dab tu bsdad nas yig sna sna tshogs sog mi'i 'khor lo 'bri/ phyugs kyi 'dre brdung en tsam 'chol ba gcig yong bar 'dug byas pas/ phyis nas 'bul ba chen po skyel du byung nas gtam gtong ma nus so/ /yang 'phan yul gyi bya'u dar nga la rkun ma byed du byung nas/ ci yang ma thob pa dang / da mos pa skad byas nas phye gcig blangs nas 'gro dgos snyam nas byung ba dang / khyod kyis rkun ma byas nas nga la ci yang ma thob par da phye slong ba bden/ kho la gos sna gsum dang lam rgyags bkur byas pas/ kho mos nas rab tu byung nas la ba gtsang sgom can du bsgoms pas thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong / yang sna 'bar gyi zhang bsgoms pa ming sring gnyis thugs rje chen po zhu bar byung nas/ sring mo la khyod chos sgor zhugs nas khyim thab yid la byed pa tsam gcig thugs rje chen po'i phyogs su gyis shig byas pas/ mo na re/ de snga'i rnam rtog mthol lo bshags/ blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/

zer nas dam bca' drag po byas nas bsgrubs nas/ lo bdun nas thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong ba byung ngo / /de la sogs pa mi rtsar byung ba phal cher gyi tshe ring thung dang / rnam rtog ci skyes thams cad bshad pas 'ga' dang rgya'i rgyal pos thos nas 'bul ba mang po bskur nas byung ba dang / yang dbus gtsang gi dge bshes dang / sde dpon phal cher mos nas chos zhu ba dang / 'bul ba phal cher bskur ba dang / rten sku'i rab gnas la sogs pa zhu ba dang / bar chod 'ong mi 'ong dang / tshe ring thung la sogs pa 'drir byung tshad la bshad pas thams cad mos nas byung yang / mched grogs lha sdings pas phrag dog byas nas skur ba btab ste/ dbon ston 'di sras po dar ma seng ge bya ba yin/ khos bram ze'i the rangs gcig bsgrubs nas brdzun bshad pas thams cad mgo 'khor nas/ da kho la log 'tsho'i bsod nams che tshad skyes 'dug zer ro/ /de'ang sngon gyi las ngan yin te/ nga skye ba mang po'i sngon rol du rgya gar lho phyogs su paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pha la bya ba la grwa pa lnga bcu tsam bsten pa'i chos shin tu mkhas pa gcig du gyur nas rgya gar gyi phyogs thams cad na theg pa che chung gi chos la nga las mkhas pa ye mi 'dug snyam nas/ zhe sdang dang phrag dog gi kun slong med kyang chos 'di yin dang / 'di min dang / dag ma dag gi bshags ral phye bas thams cad nga'i srol la zhugs so/ /de ltar bshags ral phye bas de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas gang du skyes kyang skur ba sha stag byung ngo / /da res kyang thugs rje chen po la sogs pa'i yi dam mang po'i zhal mthong / bla ma shangs pa'i bka' drin gyis sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs nas 'od gsal gyi gsal snang chen po'i stobs kyis gzhan rgyud shes par byung nas/ gzhan la phan par 'dug nas bshad pas skur ba 'di byung ba yin te/ da res kyi 'dis las ngan gyi lhag ma thams cad deng sang dag nas/

skye ba phyi ma la phun sum tshogs pa'i gdul bya 'byung bar 'dug go /de'ang las ngan gyi rnam smin 'di 'jigs par 'dug pas/ mi dge ba chung ngu la yang 'dzem pas/ bshags pa myur du byed pa 'di gal che bar 'dug snyam mo/ /de nas byang rtse ler na/ rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng zhes bya ba/ bla ma shangs pa lo bcu gnyis bsten pa'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa grub thob gcig 'dug zer nas/ nam la sos ka gcig mjal du phyin pas mkha' spyod dkar dmar dang / dges rdor/ bde mchog dang / mgon po'i gnad mig dang / dmigs pa'i sgrom bu dang / 'pho ba la sogs pa'i zhal gdams mang du zhus so/ /de nas 'dam pa cog ston la dpal dga' lo'i chig rgyud rnams mnga' ba dang / grub thob tu 'dug pas de la bla ma dpal gyi gdams ngag rnams zhus so/ /de nas sos ka de chos bshad kyin yod tsa na/ bla ye la thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong pa zhal mthong ngo / /yang mtsho chen po pad+mas brgyan pa gcig gi dkyil na pad+ma'i+i sdong po shin tu rgyas pa zhig gi steng na thugs rje chen po rtsa phyag bzhi bcu pa gcig bzhugs nas 'dug pa la/ pad+ma'i gseb na yar bltas pas lha klu mang po chos zhu yin 'dug pa gcig zhal mthong ba dang / de'i khro zhal gyi spyan gsum gyi dbus ma las bgegs thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer mthing kha gcig byung nas bdag gi so la phog pas 'bu srin dang sdig pa la sogs pa mang po thon song ba dang / so rgyun du na ba de sangs te grag go /de nas yang phyugs nad gcig byung ba la nad zhi ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ tho rangs 'jigs byed dang dgra nag gi lha tshogs rnams byon nas nad 'dre ma thams cad gsad pa dang / rengs pa dang / bskrad pa dang / nad zhag gsum nas chad do/ /de yang gshin rje gshed nag po dang / 'jigs byed dang / rta mgrin gsum gyi sgo nas smyon pa brgya dang bcu tsam btul lo/

/de la bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa dang / snang ba bden med du rtogs par ma gyur par gdon dang smyo ba btul bar grib dang 'gras chen po 'ong bar 'dug pas/ btub tshad kyis ma byed cig yang gdung rten rgyal po can gcig la rab gnas byas pas/ rgyal po de 'gror ma btub pas/ rten de la rdo rje gcig brgyab nas drag po gcig bcun pas 'chan nas rab gnas legs kyang / nga la 'gras en tsam byed du byung nas/ sbyin sreg gcig byas la/ rgyal po 'di gtan nas brlag pa gcig byed dgos snyam tsa na slob dpon pad ma byon nas/ gdon chen po ma brdung / nyams pa ma skong / klu chen po la sbyin bsreg ma byed/ chig rgyud ma spel/ sngags pa la ma gshe/ mched grogs la phrag dog ma byed/ sems can blos spang mi bya gsung ngo / /de nas nga'i rtog pa la/ bla ma yang ci tsam bzhugs mi shes/ nga rang nam 'chi mi shes/ de snga yang 'bul ba drag pa lan gnyis byas pa yin/ da bla ma gdan drangs la ci yod thams cad 'bul dgos snyam nas spyan 'dren du btang bas/ bla ma byon nas tshes bcu'i dgong mo mchod pa shoms shig nyams rtogs bsdur dgos gsungs nas rang gi dge sbyor skyes pa rnams bshad pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas rgya gar gyi grub thob rnams kyi zhal nas bla ma shangs pa la khyed kyi dge sbyor gyi skye tshul 'di lta bu su la yang ma byung gsung bar 'dug nga la bla ma shangs pa'i zhal nas rin chen brtson 'grus kyi dge sbyor gyi skye tshul 'di lta bu nga la yang ma byung gsungs/ dbon ston gyi lha sku dang 'od gsal gyi rtsol ba 'di lta bu nga la yang ma byung ste/ lar dpon slob gnyis su 'tshogs pa la 'o skol gnyis las nyams rtogs bzang ba med par thag chod pas/ dga' ba khyad par can sgoms shig da lta bla ma shangs pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can 'di la mkha' 'gro dngos su 'du ba yin pas/ 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus su song tsa na/

yang na bka' 'chad/ yang na tshong 'dus kyi 'o mar 'gro bar 'dug pas/ ngas dang po rig pa dwangs dus su ji ltar bshad pa bzhin yi ger bkod nas gsungs pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang dngos yin pas bkod par zhu byas pas/ 'o na mchod pa bskyar ma gcig shoms la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang spos phul zhig gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /gsungs nas gsol ba drag po btab pas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma byon nas spyir chos drug dang / khyad par du 'jam spyod gsungs/ de nas nangs par 'bul ba byed pa'i mang ja bskol byas nas 'bul ba rnams spungs nas bla ye la 'byon par zhu byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ da sngon la steng du 'deng ngo / /gsungs nas phyin pas/ da phyam tshe phud la spa mkhar yar phyor zhig o ba la mdzo skyes bya ba lan gsum gyis shig nga ba yin/ dbon ston khyod mdzo yin pas/ ba las mdzo skyes bya ba yin no/ /dus de ring las nyams dga' ba tsam cang yod dam gsung ngo / /de nas bla ma bla ye la byon nas 'bul ba phyag tu bzhes pa dang / da rang re thams cad bshags pa gyis la gsol ba thob cig gsungs tsa na/ phal cher gyis bla ma bde mchog lha drug bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du mthong ngo / /der 'bul ba thebs che ba lan gsum byas pas/ 'bul ba thebs re la dge sbyor gyi stobs mi 'dra ba re byung bas/ zhing dag pa'i bla ma la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas smon lam 'debs pa 'di gal che bar 'dug snyam mo/ /de nas lo mang ma lon bar/ bla ma gshegs kyis dogs nas tshes bco brgyad kyi nub mo rmi lam bzung nas bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin tsa na/ gzim chung na mkha' 'gro ma mang po 'dug mi ma yin mang po yang 'dug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas dbon ston byon pa de dga'/ da myur du 'gro bas/ sang dgong yang shog gsung bas phyin pa dang / bla ma mi bzhugs par 'dug pas mang po ngus pa dang / rje btsun ma byon nas/ da lta bde ba can na 'od dpag med dang mjal nas/

mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su gshegs par yod pas/ der gsol ba thob cig nam mkha' 'di la skye 'chi med pa ltar/ /bla ma la yang skye 'chi ga la yod/ /mos gus stobs kyis 'bral med gnas pa yin/ /mya ngan ma byed mngon dgar gsol ba thob/ /gsungs nas/ nga rang yang mngon dgar 'gro dgos snyam tsa na gnyid sad do/ /de nas zhag gsum gsang nas mchod pa phul gsol ba btab pa dang / shangs nas bang chen pa byung ste/ bla ma gshegs zer ba byung ba dang / khong rnams kyis nga la gsang 'dug nas/ ngas nam langs ma thag 'khor rnams bsags nas/ bla ma gshegs nas zhag gsum song / da nga'i cha rkyen thams cad dge 'dun la mchod pa gyis/ khyed rnams kyis kyang ci yod phul byas nas/ zla ba gcig tu bla ma'i mchod pa byas nas/ de nas tshes brgyad kyi snga dro thugs rje chen po byon nas/ mtshams ma byed par rig gtad dang sgrub thabs zhus tshad la thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas thugs rje chen po'i chos ston zhig snyigs ma'i dus su khyod kyis bstan pa'i sgrub lugs dar zhing zhal mthong ba mang du 'byung bar 'gyur gsung / de nas thugs rje chen po zhu tshad la ster ba'i go cha chen po gyon nas yod pa yin ste/ chos thun brgyad po 'di yang tshar bar nyan nus pa mi 'ong bar 'dug go /yang tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma phyed yol tsa na bcu gcig zhal byon nas/ nga dang khyod ni dbyer med de/ /skyer pa sgang pa'i po to la/ /gsungs pas/ gzhan du dge sbyor byas pa bas/ skyer sgang du gnyid log pa dga' ba yin no/ /da nga'i slob ma stod lungs kyi shi skyid pa thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong / thod lo skor ba la sogs pa'i slob ma lnga bcus zhal mthong 'dug pa dang / nga'i slob ma yang slob brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams kyis zhal mthong ba mang du 'ong bar 'dug ste/ nga'i 'di zhal mthong ba 'ba' zhig gi rgyud pa yin pa dang / thugs rje chen pos ma 'ongs pa'i dus su yang zhal mthong ba mang du 'byung bar lung bstan pas the tshom yid gnyis mi dgos so/

/bdag gi rnam thar bsdus pa 'di/ dge bshes grags ye dang / nag po gzhon tshul gnyis kyi don du bkod pa yin no/ /de nas bla ma dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum bzhes pa'i ston zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad nas sku skyed en tsam bsnyung bar byung bas rim gro'am sman dpyad re byed par zhus pas/ sman dang rim gro byas kyang tshes bco lnga la sangs drag nas 'ong bar 'dug gsungs nas ci yang ma gnang ngo / /de nas tshes bcu gsum la/ tshogs sogs gyis gsung nas byas pas/ bcu bzhi la drag nas 'dug gi gsung nas sang dbu che rnams tshogs shig ngas chos bshad pa yin no gsungs nas/ snga dro na bsags pas da tshogs sam byas pas tshogs gda' zer/ pha ma'i dang / rtsis mkhan gyi rtsis ltar byas kyang rung / rlung rtsis ltar byas kyang pho lo bzhi bcu las mi thub pa 'dug pa yin te bla ma shangs pa'i sku drin gyis pho lo bdun cu gsum thub/ lo brgya lhag tsam 'phrad bsam pa yin te/ khyed rnams la skyo ba skye bar byung bas da 'gro ba yin/ jo btsun dar she khyod snyam na lo re 'bum brgya tshar re bya snyam ste/ chos mi la bcol ba yin/ ston pa dkon she khyod snyam na chos nga las mkhas pa med snyam ste/ chos dang sems su ma 'dres par 'dug pa/ rgyal po dpe kar la ltos/ thang pa jo btsun dang chos mgon gnyis snyam na zla ba ngo re la ston mo bzang po re byas pas chos 'grub pa yin snyam ste/ ngas byas che la dran 'dren pa'i dge ba chos brgyad kyi ston mo de des 'khar che che na 'brog bzang po'i phyugs der skye ba srid/ nga la chos byed dus su khyed rnams chos mi dran par/ sang na sar thug tsa na sha ba nyung mas snang ba bzhin/ lag ngar sngas su bcug nas mid pa thugs thugs byas nas/ ngo nag ting ting byed kyin da res ma shi na chos bsha' ma gcig byed de zer ba'i ngang la 'chi ba 'ong gis/ ngas dang po chos dran dus na dran/

bar du byed dus na byas/ tha ma dgos dus su sleb pa yin no/ /gzhon nu 'od spos phul dang / brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang byon/ thugs rje chen po dang yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyang byon no/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang nam mkha' khengs pa byon pa 'dug pas gsol ba thob gsung ngo / /de nas skyer sgang 'dir mjug tu ji lta bu gcig 'ong zhus pas/ 'di na klu dang srin mo thu ba gcig yod pa yin te ngas btul ba yin/ nga'i byin rlabs ma nyams ring la skyer sgang 'di po ta la dngos yin pas/ gzhan du ri khrod dang 'dag char byas pa bas 'dir gnyid log pa dga' ba yin no/ /da bzod mtha' mi dbus su sdug pa'i stobs kyis 'bum thang 'dir khyi lud thor gyis 'byung / bud med sham bu can gyis bzhud ta bkye re ba 'ong bar 'dug de tsa na nga'i byin rlabs nyams pa yin pas/ de'i dus na klu dang klu srin mo langs nas/ thub pa yang nyung du 'gro/ rtse gcig sgrub pa byed pa'ang mi 'ong bar 'dug go /gsungs so/ /de nas bla ma 'di nas gang du gshegs/ gsol ba gang du btab/ chos brgyud 'di sus 'dzin zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyed rnams nga la mos na shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig gi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur bas/ der gsol ba thob cig sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ngas chos brgyud 'di g.yor po stod nas 'dzin mkhan gcig 'ong ste/ rdo rje 'chang gis lung bstan pa bzhin du mi rabs bdun du brgyud pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal gdams 'di rnams phyogs kun tu khyab cing / gdul bya snod dang ldan pa mang du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsungs nas/ gdul byas 'di thams cad mi rtag pa'am/ sems can rnams kyi snang ngor dgongs nas/ dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas sku gshegs so/

/grub thob skyer pa sgang pa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho las/ 'dir chu thigs tsam gcig yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// // ༈ /skyer sgang pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar bka' brgya ma bzhugs so// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /skyer pa sgang pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /yos bu'i lo/ khyi zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nub mo mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi byin rlabs gcig mdzad pa'i dus su/ nye gnas gzhon tshul dang / grags yes dang / nga dang gsum las med pa'i dus su rin po che'i zhal nas/ ji ltar 'dab gshog ma rgyas par/ /bya yis mkha' la 'phur mi nus/ /de bzhin mngon shes rtogs bral bas/ /sems can don byed nus ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa de bden par 'dug da lta mngon par shes pa bag tsam la brten nas 'gro don yang 'grub par 'dug gsungs/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyi phyag na snam bu bdun yod pa phul nas/ 'o na rin po che nyid gang du skye ba bzhes pa dang / gang du bzhud lags zhes zhus pas de 'dra bag tsam yod de blo yul du mi tshud gsung / de ltar yang nas yang du zhus pas/ bka' rgya btab nas gnang ba yin pas/ dad pa dang gus pa gcig gnyis ma gtogs pa gzhan la 'grims na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros sgrol zhig gsungs nas gnang ba yin pas shin tu dam par bya gsungs/ de la bdag gi bla ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa du ma'i zhal gzigs pa/ 'gro ba'i dpal mgon du gyur pa de/ rgya gar gyi mtha' 'khob sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa med pa/ ngam 'brog dang g.yang sa dang / tsher ma sna tshogs par/ kri krim zhes pa'i rigs/ yab ral pa can zhes pa dang / yum uṣ+ma zhes bya ba gnyis la sras bdun yod pa'i lnga tshogs ma gzi brjid grags pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /des dgung lo bdun lon nas ba glang rdzi'u byas te/

gnas pa bzang po yod kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ma mjal bas ngo ma shes gsungs/ grong der mi ring ba gcig na tshong 'dus yod pa'i sar byon pas/ rnal 'byor pa gcig stag la zhon nas ral gri nam mkha' la bskor bas me tog gi char 'bebs pa gcig gzigs/ de la mos nas phyag dang bskor ba byas nas thugs rje 'dzin par zhus pas/ byed pa thams cad kun rdzob yin/ /byed med rtogs na mya ngan 'da'/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /tshogs gnyis 'gro ba'i don du sog /gsungs nas/ nam mkha' la gshegs te/ snga ma de gsal btab pa bzhin song nas/ ting nge 'dzin mtha' dbus med pa byung ste/ ri brag gcig la bsgoms pas/ nam mkha' la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal la/ 'od zer can dang / sgrol ma dang / ral gcig ma dang / rma bya chen mo la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba zhal gzigs/ de nas chu bo mu ni zhes bya bar sgrub pa mdzad pas/ chu bo de'i 'gram na sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang gcig gi drung na/ mdze mo gcig na re/ khyod chos 'dod dam zer/ zhu gsungs pas/ rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can/ /zung 'jug snying rje'i rta la zhon/ /rang gzhan gnyis kyi don des 'grub/ /gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas pha ma la sogs pa chos bstan yang gdul bya mang po ni ma byung / bdun cu rtsa gcig la 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas yang rin po che mnga' ris stod du sku 'khrungs te/ mnga' ris stod du sku skye ba bzhes gsungs zhes bya ba de/ yul lha shod ces par grong khyer ra ma can zhes bya ba/ yab zhang zhung btsun pa zhes bya ba/ yum 'od ldan ma zhes bya ba la sras gnyis yod pa'i nu bo dar ma tsan zhes bya bar 'khrungs nas/ lo bcu bdun la gnas pa bzang po yod de/ yab la chos byed pa'i bla ma gang bzang dris pas/

yab na re nged kyi rigs ni bon po'i rigs yin pas khyod kyang bon slobs zer nas khrid nas song / drang srong mig gsum pa zhes pa la bon mkhas par bslabs nas/ ti se'i byang ngos su dbang phyug chen po'i rdzong / drang srong kar rgyal gyi gnas su bsgrubs pas/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa ston nus pa byung gsung / dus gcig na brag de'i mdun na bya dkar po shin tu mdzes pa gcig na re/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom pas gdungs/ /rin chen gling nas stong par 'gro/ /bya ba ngan la ma zhen par/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bsgral na bzang / /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas khang pa'i nang na log nas bsams pas/ skyes pa'i mtha' 'chi/ 'dus pa'i mtha' bral rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo dran nas/ sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas bsgoms pas/ sngar gyi bya de spyan ras gzigs gyi sprul pa yin par shes te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la mtha' dbus med pa'i snying rje chen po skyes nas gzhan don mang po 'grub gsungs/ yang dus gcig na yul de'i rgyal po dza zhes pa phyi rol pa/ nus pa can gcig yod pa de na re/ zhang zhung gi bu khyod gzhan don gang gi sgo nas byed zer/ byang chub kyi sems so zhes gsungs pas/ kho khros nas lus dpag tshad stong du sprul nas/ lag pa stong nas mtshon chas char phab/ de la phyi rol sgyu mar gtan la phab pa dang / nang 'dzin pa'i sems rang bzhin med par shes pas/ me tog gi char par gyur pa la/ rgyal po mos te nang pa'i bstan pa la bkod par byas gsung / yang dus gcig na mtha'i rgyal pos dpung yan lag bzhi pa'i dmag drangs pas/ ngas de la byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ dmag thams cad thugs rje chen por skur bsgyur nus pa byung gsungs so/ /yang las 'ga' zhig gis/ lus la 'brum bu nag po'i nad kyis btab pas/ rig pa sems la na rgyu med kyang /

rnam smin gyi lus la na tsha chen po byung ste/ 'o dod drag po bos pas nam mkha' la rje btsun ma dkar mo byon nas/ rnam smin gyi lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ zhes gsungs pa la brten nas zab mo'i chos mang po rgyud la skyes gsungs/ yang rin po che'i gsung nas dgung lo bdun cu la mdzad pa mthar phyin par mdzad nas sman gyi ljongs ces par 'phags pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i drung du mya ngan las 'das te/ rgya nag tu skye ba bzhes gsungs so/ /yang rgya nag po'i yul rgya mtsho'i 'gram na/ grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba mi khyim 'bum tsho yod par/ rigs mtho ba yab gaṅgā zhes pa/ yum ni ra ma zhes pa de gnyis kyi sras pad ma'i dpal zhes bya bar gyur to/ /yab la dong tse rnying pa bang ba stong yod pa la sbyin pa ni mi byed pa la/ rin po che pas lo bdun lon pas yab la ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro bar zhus pas/ ci shi bar 'gro'am de las log pa ni med zer ro/ /der yid chad de brag seng ge rgyab snol du byon nas 'jam dpal la gsol ba btab pas/ 'jam dpal pad+ma'i dpal la 'khor lha mo brgyad kyis skor ba zhal gsum phyag drug sku mdog dkar po nam mkha' la byon nas/ brjod du med pa snying po'i don/ /ma yengs sgom pa 'bru'i don/ /de nyid shes pa sgom du med/ /nam mkha'i ngang la nam mkha' lta/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sngar gyi de gsal btab pa ltar ting nge 'dzin mtha' dbus med pa skyes te/ spyod pa mdzad du/ rgya'i bkra shis khri sgo zhes par/ 'phrul gyi rgyal po dharma shrī zhes pa sngon sangs rgyas la dad pa/ phyis mu stegs pa la zhugs pa de ma he stong stong gsod par gyur pa de 'dul ba'i don du/ gzhon nu karti kar sprul nas byon pas/ rgyal pos yi dam byon gdan la bzhugs/ ma he sgrol zer ba dang / karti kas nga'i zas de min gsungs pa dang / 'o na gang yin dris pas/ de'i lan du/ dkar gsum mngar gsum lan tsha dri/

/sdig med 'bras bu nga'i zas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po na re/ zas su sha za skom du khrag 'thung ba/ /lha chen mahā de ba'i rigs min nam/ /zer ba dang / karti kas snying kha nas drag po'i phrin las kyi me skye bas 'tshig la khad pa dang / rgyal pos zhus pa/ thugs dang 'gal ba bzod par gsol/ las gang yin pa bya'o zhes zer ba la/ de nyid dge ba bcu la bkod de/ gang la gang 'dul de la der ston bya ba de la zer ba yin gsungs/ yang rgya nag gi yul skar ma can zhes bya ba na/ phra men zangs kyi mdog can bya ba/ nub re la mi re za ba gcig yod pas/ de 'dul ba la gnod sbyin zangs kyi mgo can du sprul te/ de dang khyo shug byas te/ mo yid phab pa dang / ngag tu yi ge drug pa bgrangs pas/ mo na re ci yin zer/ zas tshol ba'i sngags so byas pas/ mo yang dad de mang du bgrangs pas/ 'phags pa'i thugs rje las sad de/ nang pa la tshud nas bde bar byas gsungs/ yang rgyal po mun pa'i gos bya ba la sogs pa mang po btul nas/ dgung lo drug cu la zhi bar gshegs so/ /de nyid nas thag mi ring ba gcig na a ra tha zhes pa'i grong du skyes so/ /de yang a ra tha zhes pa'i grong de'i nub na nags mthug po gcig gi nang na sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gcig yod pa la/ spre'u stong zhig gnas pas dri dang chus ma rungs pa byas pa rnams ngan 'gror 'gro ba la dgongs nas/ spre'u'i rgyal por skye ba bzhes te/ de yang bzhin sdug pa/ bong che ba/ dbu la rin po che'i zhwa gsol ba/ phyag na shing gi phreng ba 'dzin par sprul nas/ mchod rten de la phyag dang skor ba bslabs pas shes nas/ rgyu 'bras kyi chos bstan pas go bar gyur te gsungs pa/ 'o skol spre'u rnams gson zhig phyi snang ba 'bral med 'di lta ba/ nang rig pa 'dzin med 'di sgom pa/ bar blang dor med pa 'di spyod pa yin gsungs pas/ de dag gi bden pa rtogs pa mang du byung ste/

bde ba la bkod pas/ yul de'i mi rnams na re/ nags gseb ya gi na spre'u gcig gis de dag thams cad bde ba la bkod ces smra zhing / lta ba mang du byung ste/ rgyal po gcig gis spre'u rgyal po la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed rnams ci'i phyir bde bar gnas/ bde bar 'tsho/ spre'us smras pa/ rigs kyi mchog gyur rgyal po bdag la gson/ /rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /mi bslu tshad mar blo thag chod/ /ye nas gnas pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /chos sku bde ba chen por go /de nyid brdzun po yin na spre'u shi/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas dad de/ e ma ho ngo mtshar re che zhes phyag dang skor ba byas nas slar song ngo / /de nas spre'u'i rgyal po des 'khor rnams la smras pa/ rang cag spre'u thams cad dang / snang ba ji ltar snang yang rung / tshogs drug zhen 'dzin med par zhog /rnam rtog ji ltar skyes kyang rung / /sems nyid bzhi rtsa med par zhog /dug lnga ji ltar skyes kyang rung / /'od gsal chos sku chen por zhog /slar log ste/ e ma ngo mtshar che zhes gdong mchi ma dang bcas te gsungs pas/ thams cad kyis bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe nam mkha' la 'ja' dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas chen po byung ste/ rang yang ngo mtshar skyes so/ ༈ /de yang rin po che de nyid bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du mya ngan las lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la 'das te/ rgya gar gyi yul yangs pa can du sku 'khrungs so/ ༈ /de yang rgya gar gyi shar phyogs/ li byi'i gnas bya ba yangs pa can du grags pa'i grong khyer gcig gi dbus na/ rigs bram ze/ yab tshong dpon bzang po dpal dang / yum zla ba'i 'od zer bya ba la sras bdun gyi thog ma gzi brjid bya bar sku 'khrungs te/ lo bcu bdun la o tan+na pu ri bya bar/ mkhan po khyu mchog rgyal ba la rab tu byung / mtshan yang shes rab go cha yin/ phal chen pa'i sde yin gsungs/

ka ma la shī la la rigs pa'i tshogs mnyan/ de'i dus su mu stegs rag sha srin po'i gdong can zhes pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams par byed pa rigs pa'i sgo nas tshar bcad gsung / yang rnal 'byor pa nyi ma sbas pa bya ba rigs pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta za hor yul nas byung ba dang / rtsod pa byas pas ma thub par bla mar gyur pa de nga'i bla ma mnyam med rin po che rmog pa yin gsungs/ nub phyogs ka ling ka zhes pa'i dur khrod du rang byung mchod rten gcig gi drung du sgrub pa la phyin pas/ rnal 'byor pa bong thung ba/ spyan rtsa dmar ba/ shing gi ral gri bzung ba gcig na re/ tshe la long med yun rings mi sdod nges/ /thos pa'i thag chod rig pa nang du khug /ma bcos dri med me long nang du ltos/ /'khor ba spangs nas myang 'das sgrub tu med/ /ces gsungs pas/ chos du ma ro gcig tu go de nga'i bla ma spen phug pa yin gsung / de nas keng rus la me 'bar ba'i dur khrod du byon nas spyod pa mdzad gsungs/ de nas rnal 'byor pa mi na ra sa zhes pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa gcig na re/ khyed ci byed gsungs/ spyod pa la 'ongs gsungs pas/ khong na re/ nags tshal mthongs su bsgoms na bde ba thob/ /thams cad sems su shes na mi mthun med/ /ces gsungs pas spyod pa la bogs chen po byung / de nga'i bla ma rtsa ri sgom pa de yin gsungs/ de nas dpal yon can du skor ba byas pas/ mchod rten de'i rtsa na rnal 'byor pa stag la zhon pa nyi ma'i gos can bya ba na re/ dran pa rang sangs chu'i ri mo 'dra/ /'gag pa med pa nyi ma'i snying po 'dra/ /rig pa snang ba me long nang dang 'dra/ /gsal la ma 'gags shel gyi sgo nga 'dra/ /gsungs nas phyag spyi bor bzhag pas ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa rgyud la skyes/ de nga'i bla ma zhang sgom chos seng yin gsung / de nas rdo rje gdan du spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang gcig lta bar bzhed nas byon pas/

lam kha gcig na/ rgan mo pad ma'i phreng ba gon pa gcig na re gar 'gro zer/ ār+ya pha lo ltar 'gro gsungs pas/ mo na re/ byams pa snying rje byang chub sems/ /bsgoms na rang nyid thugs rje che/ /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas mthong ba med/ /snying rje zung 'jug spyan ras gzigs/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nga'i bla ma lce sgom yin gsungs/ de nas grong khyer shing thags can du dgung lo brgyad bcu la mya ngan las 'das so/ ༈ /de'i rjes la byang phyogs kyi cha nang go sa rgyud gsum las nam smad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung bai ḍūr+yas bris pa bzhugs pa'i sa brag seng ge'i sna rtser/ thang pa 'gro khams kyi rigs su 'khrungs so/ /de yang lo bdun nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la bsnyen pa mdzad gsung / de nas khu bo 'bal tshad ma zhes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gcig bzhugs pa'i sar rab tu byon/ thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad pa cher mdzad de/ gdan sa phrin las mang pos 'gro don mdzad pa gzhan du shes so/ /rin po che'i zhabs tog mdzad nas yang rin po che la zhus pa/ 'di nas gang du gshegs par 'gyur/ bdag cag thams cad gsol ba gang du btab zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas 'di nas shi 'phos nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su pad+ma'i tshal du rdzus te skyes pa la/ rgyal po nyi ma'i gnyen rdzing bur khrus la gshegs pas mthong ba dang / de dga' mgu yi rang bas 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha'am klu'am gnod sbyin gang gi bu/ /pad ma las skyes pad+ma las 'khrungs te/ /bdag gi sras bya khang bzang dam par gshegs/ /zhes rin po che'i khri la bzhag nas mchod pa du mas mchod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten ke zhes bya ba 'phang du dpag tshad gsum yod pa gcig bzhugs/ de'i drung du phyin nas mchod pa du mas mchod nyi ma gcig la sems can mang po'i don byas nas nub phyogs su sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa'i sar smon lam gyi shugs drag pos mtshams sbyar te/

sems can bye ba phrag khrig mang po bde ba la bkod nas u brgyan du byon te/ mkha' 'gro ma bde ba nor bu'i sar gsang sngags kyi spyod pa la zhugs nas gdul bya mang po rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god pa yin gsung / khyod kyang de'i dus su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhis khrid nas nga'i drung du 'ongs nas/ rnal 'byor pa ka ru pa zhes par gyur nas gsang ba bla na med pa'i spyod pa mdzad do/ /de'i gdul bya dang mnyam gsung / rdzu 'phrul la khyad par yod pas nyi ma gcig la lus rigs mi 'dra bar sprul nas sems can smin par byed nus gsungs/ de nas nub phyogs kyi grong khyer dpe med ces bya ba de na ta ma la rus pa'i gos can zhes bya bar gyur nas nyin mo skyes pa lnga brgyar sgyur nas zhing las byon/ mtshan mo bud med lnga brgyar sgyur nas gsang sngags kyi spyod pa byed pa zhig yod/ des khyed smin pa dang grol bar byas nas mthar 'og min du sangs rgyas zhi ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i drung du byang chub sems dpa' tog gi rgyal po zhes bya bar gyur nas 'gro ba mang po'i mgon du 'gyur gsung / de nas rin po che gang du 'gro don mdzad zhus pas/ rin po che'i gsung nas nga de nas ta ma la rus pa'i gos can gyis mkha' la chu la chu bzhag pa'am/ mar la mar bzhag pa bzhin thim nas shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i drung du tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams baiḍūr+ya snang ba bya bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa dri med snang ba'i dpal gyi drung du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur gsungs/ nga'i 'jig rten gyi khams de khyad par 'phags pa snang ba zhes bya ba/ mtshan ni pad+ma'i bla ma zhes bya/ yab tshangs pa'i rgyal po/ yum pad ma'i snying po/ sras zla ba'i tog rim 'gro pa zla mdzes/ 'dus pa ni 'bum phrag dgu sku tshe lo stong /

dam pa'i chos lnga khri drug stong gnas par 'gyur gsungs/ da lta nga'i rgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sangs rgyas de'i drung du tshangs par spyod pa yin pas/ chos thams cad sgyu mar gtan la phob dang gsungs/ lar zhing khams dag ma dag dang / 'khor rgya che chung dang sku tshe'i tshad gdul bya la sogs pa thams cad sgyu ma'i snang ba yin/ de gtan la phab pa'i gang zag la bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med/ 'o na gzugs sku gnyis kyis sems can gyi don byed gsungs pa de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ de dag pa'i 'khrul snang yin/ nam mkhas nam mkha' mtshon du med/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas yang rmi lam sgyu mar gsungs pa de snang ba tsam bkag pa yin gsungs/ 'o na rgyud pa 'di dar mi dar ci mchi zhus pas/ rdo rje 'chang dang mi la yan chad la gdul bya de tsam med/ bla ma rje btsun lha rje nas byung ba yin/ nga'i rgyud pa 'di yang khyed nas bzang du 'gro/ nga'i grwa pa 'di yang slob dpon chen po'i shul yin gsungs/ khyod kyang 'khor bzang med par skyongs gsungs/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'dis ci smras pa nyan par 'dug gis gsungs/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa bya ba yang khyod la tshang ba yin/ lar gcig rgyu yin pas khyod legs par 'ong gsungs/ yang zhus pa/ spyir sems can thams cad la/ dgos su zhal mthong gsung thos pa rnams la thugs rje dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bzung bar zhu zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir sems can thams cad la phyogs dang ris su chad pa med/ nam mkha'i mthas khyab tshad jo bo thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul gyi khyab pa yin la/ dgos su bdag mthong ba dang thos pa rnams la dran pa thams cad kyang don dang bcas pa yin pas mos pa dang gus pa byed pa lta ci smos gsung gdan sa rin po che 'di je bzang la 'gro ba gcig thugs la thogs zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas byis pa kun gyi bye ma'i khang pa dang 'dra/
